_comment: SINGLE model registry for all five comparison table families. Supersedes the per-family
configs (pose_fidelity_models.json, delta_score_models.json), which stay on disk during
Phase A and are reproduced from this file by scripts/model_registry.py -- run
scripts/check_registry_sync.py to prove the reproduction is exact.
WHY: the same model was known by up to six different strings. Our main model is
'vina_fixed' (eval_out dir), 'vina_fixed_best' (PLIP tag), 'vina_fixed_on' (delta tag),
'Ours (vina_fixed_best)' (F1 label), 'Ours (guidance ON)' (F4 label) and 'Ours (Vina loss)'
(F3 label). Joining families by display string was impossible. Every family-specific string
now lives under ids.*, and nothing joins on a label.
FIELDS
id        stable key, never rendered
tier      reference | core | extended | ablation | quarantine
order     row order within a table (ascending). Deterministic, unlike sorting by a metric.
ids.*     per-family identifiers. null = this family has no directory/tag for the model.
sources   'default' plus per-family overrides. They legitimately differ: IPDiff's F1/F2
read the _chem_ variant while F3 reads the plain one.
counts    namespaced per family ON PURPOSE. vina_fixed is 9857 for pose (exported) and
8340 for delta (docking-successful). Collapsing them would break the n_mols
assertion in delta_score_common.load_model_pockets, the strongest data-integrity

check in this repo. Each count carries a `basis` saying WHAT it counts: 'exported_sdf' (molecules in dir/sdf/) vs 'docking_successful'. Comparing n_mols across two different bases is meaningless, which is why check 5 of scripts/check_registry.py compares only within a basis.
families  declared availability, never inferred:
ok             measured and reportable
not_measured   no data on disk; re-measuring is out of scope this pass
not_applicable structurally impossible (protocol or data shape forbids it)
deferred       data exists but wiring the row was postponed
underpowered   measured, but n too small to carry a claim

retired        measured and KEPT on disk, but deliberately excluded from reporting by user decision (pignet_fixed / pgdiff_fixed, 2026-08-05). This is the distinction tier alone cannot make: novdw is also tier 'ablation' but IS reported.
docked_policy  how docking success is decided. Replaces the ad-hoc CONNECTED_IS_DOCKED set
and the "'dock' if any(...) else 'minimize'" sniffing duplicated in three
builders.
POPULATION RULE: every family aggregates DOCKING-SUCCESSFUL molecules only, no exceptions.
External papers ship .pt files already filtered that way, so including our failures would
evaluate us on a wider population. docked <=> connected holds here, so this filter selects
the same set as 'connected only'.
RETIRED 2026-08-05 (user decision): pignet_fixed and pgdiff_fixed are tier 'ablation' and no
longer appear in any main table. Their eval_out/ outputs and source .pt files are KEPT, so
restoring them is a tier change, not a re-measurement.

LABELS UNIFIED 2026-08-21: every family now renders the canonical `label`. The families.<f>.legacy_label pins were a migration aid -- they held each table at its published string so a roster change could be verified as rows-only before any rename landed. That verification is done, so they are gone.
REMOVED 2026-08-21 (user decision D9): DrugGPS, ResGen and DiffSBDD. Their ligand_filename
has no pocket-dir prefix (n_pockets = 0), so per-target metrics and off-target assignment are
both impossible, and they appear in no family but F1.

F4 ROSTER EXTENDED 2026-09-02: ipdiff, molcraft and pidiff_pub added to the delta family so all five families share one 9-model roster. Their off-target selections were appended to the EXISTING configs/offtarget_assignment_seed2027.json; because n_per_pocket = 0 no RNG draw happens, the pocket->off-target map is model-independent, and none of the three adds a new missing pocket, every previously docked row is bit-identical and common_pockets stays at 95.

F4 ROSTER ARM 2026-09-03: families.delta.report_roster + the `roster` arm. The paper table now aggregates over the 99 pockets the nine reported models share (only pocket 46 is dropped, and it is empty for both PIDiff and ours), instead of the 95 that AR and DecompDiff -- shown nowhere -- were also required to cover. No re-docking: every model was always docked on all 100 pockets and the restriction was applied at aggregation time.

canonical_pockets.note: Three code paths derive the pocket order (eval_export_sdf.canonical_ligand_files, build_comparison_tables.build_pocket_maps, offtarget_assignment_seed2027.json). They already AGREE -- the sha256 below matches test_pockets_sha256 in the off-target assignment -- so unification is an assertion to add, not a conflict to resolve.

protocol.box_note: smina/gnina --autobox_ligand <crystal ligand>; vina_meeko ref arm uses the same crystal ligand centroid with a fixed 20A cube. The min/score modes take NO box (--minimize / --score_only relax or score in place), which is what makes them box-independent.
protocol.vinardo_note: smina --scoring vinardo is the cross-scoring-function control: same binary, same Monte-Carlo search, same box, same seed, same exhaustiveness, same atom typing as the smina Vina arm -- the scoring function is the ONLY variable. Vinardo affinities are NOT on the Vina kcal/mol scale (gauss2 dropped, steric/hydrophobic/hbond terms and weights refit), so rank within the column and never difference across columns.

nci.note: D7: absolute contact counts are the main body. IFP reproduction (interaction_tables) moved to appendix/ifp -- its roster cannot match, and eval_plip_atom/ covers 15 tags against eval_plip/'s 37.

delta.n_per_pocket_note: 0 = every docking-successful molecule, matching the frozen configs/offtarget_assignment_seed2027.json. Was 20 until 2026-09-02, a stale value from the superseded n=20 run whose tables live in results/comparison/delta_score_n20/.
delta.report_roster_note: Registry ids of the models the MANUSCRIPT table shows. build_delta_score.py emits an extra arm `roster` whose pocket set is the intersection over THESE models only. The `common` arm keeps intersecting over every delta model, which is right for the internal report but wrong for the paper: AR and DecompDiff appear in no manuscript table, yet their coverage gaps at pockets 25/58/82/83 shrank every reported row from 99 pockets to 95. Must stay in sync with ROSTER in paper/tables/build_revision_tables.py -- it moved there from paper/make_tables.sh in the 2026-09-14 paper/ restructure, and make_tables.sh is now only a wrapper. scripts/check_paper_tables.py asserts that, reading the roster out of paper/data/table_specs.json which the generator writes as it runs. 2026-09-10: pidiff_pub -> pidiff_retrain here and in the generator together, since check_paper_tables.py asserts the two match. Position in the list is unchanged, so the roster pocket set is still the intersection over the same nine SLOTS.

models.label: PIDiff (retrained)
notes: From-scratch retrain of PIDiff -- the public repo (github hello-maker/PIDiff) ships NO checkpoint. This is NOT the official release: that is `pidiff_pub` (eval_out `pidiff`, plip_tag `pidiff_baseline`). Never merge the two in one table.
Naming: eval_plip/pidiff_exact is head1_dock_342k -- OUR model with PIDiff's vdW loss, not PIDiff. This entry collides with neither.

Reproduction verified on the Vina arm: mean Vina Dock -8.28 / Score -6.38 / Min -7.40 vs the author's published -8.10 / -6.58 / -7.52, all within 0.21 kcal/mol. Reconstruction yield 86.8% (8676/10000) vs the author's 85.0% (850/1000).

Selected checkpoint is iteration 31,600 of a 400,000-iteration schedule, because PIDiff's own config saves best-val only and its plateau scheduler (factor 0.6, patience 10, val_freq 100 => patience is 1,000 iters) decays the LR to min_lr by iter 35,000; val loss never improved again over the following ~1,300 validations. At that iteration the vdW curriculum weight is 31600/200000 = 0.158. Footnote this wherever the row appears -- it is not 'PIDiff trained for 400k iters'. Full write-up: /home/ktori1361/PIDiff_repro/REPRO_NOTES.md.

Trained in the `kgdiff` env (torch 1.11 / PyG 2.0.4), NOT the author-specified torch 1.13.1 / PyG 2.2.0 -- the `targetdiff` env's rdkit needs GLIBCXX_3.4.31, absent on this cluster. Results are statistically comparable, never bitwise.
Source .pt sha256 1a0f25fa91f3d471875532b437d08331ef861aac34305323a66d92c9cb44b900, copied from /lustre/ktori1361/PIDiff_repro/ on 2026-09-07.

SURVIVOR population: scripts/dock_and_eval.py drops reconstruction failures, disconnected ('.' in SMILES) molecules and Vina failures BEFORE writing, so sdf/ == 8654 and all_atoms_connected will read 100% by construction. Comparable to pidiff/targetdiff/kgdiff (also 0% fragmented) but NOT to vina_fixed, whose sdf/ retains its failures. The pre-filter triple is 10000 generated / 186 recon-fail / 1138 fragmented.

GROUPED layout: eval_export_sdf.load_grouped returns a grouped .pt verbatim with no canonical realignment and no warning, so the '[warn] matched no canonical pocket' line can never fire. Slot-by-slot equality against canonical_ligand_files() was asserted explicitly instead.

pidiff_pub covers 99 pockets (no 046) with a median of 9 molecules/pocket; this row covers 100 with a median of 90. Any paired comparison must restrict to the common 99 AND weight per pocket -- molecule-level pooling weights their pockets 10x less.
Docked in-house with scripts/dock_and_eval.py: own-bbox box, exhaustiveness 16, docking_mode vina_dock -- the same protocol as every other in-house docking.

sbdd.note: Source .pt carries chem_results + vina for all 8654. Replaces pidiff_pub in the F1 roster rather than adding an 18th row, so the expected row COUNT is unchanged.

pose.note: pose_rmsd.csv covers 8654/8654 on min+dock for vinardo and gnina with skeleton_iso fallback = 0 (baselines run up to 0.63% fallback, which biases RMSD DOWNWARD). vina_meeko is complete at 100 pockets / 8654 molecules, prep_ok 8654, 0 Jensen violations. smina (Vina scoring) was NOT run for this row -- method_*_smina is `absent` for all 8654.

models.label: Ours (Vina Only)
models.rationale: Internal ablation: same checkpoint, guide_mode no_guide. Isolates what the guidance does to selectivity.
notes: docked_policy is connected_is_docked: the F3 source noguide_grouped.pt carries no vina field at all, and it was built by load_samples which drops fragmented molecules first -- so connected == docking-successful by the docked<=>connected identity. This replaces the CONNECTED_IS_DOCKED set in build_nci_summary.py.
PLIP for this tag must be driven with --samples (per-sample id*/result_*.pt), never --pt: the consolidated .pt has no 'mol', and --pt writes 100 empty pockets silently.

quality/nci read noguide_grouped.pt while sbdd/delta read the MERGED file, and this split is deliberate. The F3/F5 SDFs were exported from noguide_grouped.pt, so the p<NNN>_m<MMMM> titles that PLIP/prolif/PoseCheck were measured against index into THAT file. Pointing nci/quality at the merged file would renumber those keys and silently empty the tables -- and re-exporting means re-measuring, which the pinned instrument versions forbid.

sources.default was the consolidated vina_fixed_best_noguide_vina_docked.pt, which carries {chem_results, ligand_filename, vina} and NO mol -- F1 Diversity came out blank because it is the one metric needing a fingerprint. Replaced 2026-08-25 by noguide_merged_vina_docked.pt (scripts/merge_split_pt.py), which is the same 2400 records with mol/smiles attached to the 2145 docked ones: the canonical shape every other model of ours already has. This retired the registry's join: docked_order, whose only user was this model.

label was 'Ours (guidance OFF)'. Renamed 2026-08-21 to a factorial scheme naming what each arm actually contains (Vina physics loss x kgdiff guidance components), replacing checkpoint-derived names like vina_fixed_best / novdw that only meant something to whoever trained them.

The main row is the uncontrolled one -- n=2145 against baselines with ~9000 -- so read n.

notes: eval_out dir is 'vina_fixed' but the PLIP tag is 'vina_fixed_best' -- the two differ, which is why nothing may join on a bare tag string.
Quote Vina DOCK, never Vina Score: the Score median beating Dock is part marginal-median artifact and part distorted-geometry exploitation.
15.4% of its generated molecules are fragmented and therefore undocked. Always report generated / fragmented / docking-successful together.

label was 'Ours (vina_fixed_best)'. Renamed 2026-08-21 to a factorial scheme naming what each arm actually contains (Vina physics loss x kgdiff guidance components), replacing checkpoint-derived names like vina_fixed_best / novdw that only meant something to whoever trained them.

models.label: Ours (Guide Only)
notes: The decisive control: same codebase, loss_vdw_weight = 0. Causal claims about the physics loss are only licensed by ours-vs-novdw, never by ours-vs-targetdiff (different codebase and training setup).
Fragments 0.0% where every contact-physics loss fragments 15-28% -- this is what makes the loss the cause.

_legacy_comments._note: Verbatim _comment blocks of the two legacy registries, kept so the shims in scripts/model_registry.py can reproduce those files exactly. Phase A only.
pose: Model roster for the pose-fidelity experiment (analysis/EXPERIMENT_pose_fidelity.md).
'dir' holds sdf/ + manifest.csv and receives smina/, gnina/, smina_vinardo/, vina_meeko/,
posebusters/, posecheck/. 'pt' is the source sampling .pt, needed only to re-run
eval_aggregate_all.py -- RMSD and strain are computed from the SDFs alone.
n_mols/n_pockets are the VERIFIED molecule counts in dir/sdf/*.sdf; build_worklist.py
asserts against them so a truncated export can never pass as complete.
'group' drives the mixed-effects model contrast: baseline = external models with no physics
loss (targetdiff is the reference level, see Phase 5).

RETIRED 2026-08-05 (user decision): pgdiff_fixed and pignet_fixed were removed from this roster and from build_comparison_tables.py, so they no longer appear in master.csv, rmsd_summary.txt, redock_comparison.txt, tables.md or comparison_tables.txt. Their eval_out/ docking outputs and source .pt files are intentionally KEPT -- only the reporting was removed, so restoring the two entries brings them back without re-docking.
delta: Model roster for the Delta Score / selectivity experiment (analysis/METHODS_delta_score.md).
Each row is docked into ONE randomly assigned off-target pocket; Delta = on - off.
'pt' is the source of BOTH the RDKit molecules and the reused on-target Vina numbers,
except for vina_fixed_noguide, whose consolidated .pt dropped the 'mol' objects -- its
molecules come from 'mol_pt' and are joined to the vina records by 'join': see below.
'layout':  grouped = list[100] of list[dict], index == pocket
flat    = {'all_results': list[dict]}, aligned by full ligand_filename
single  = list[100] of a single dict (the crystal reference set)
'join': 'docked_order' means mol_pt[i][j] corresponds to the j-th entry of pt[i] that
has a Vina dock score. Verified 2026-08-03: per-pocket counts match for all 100 pockets,
and stored chem_results QED/SA equal the values recomputed from mol_pt mols (24/24 sampled).
dock_offtarget.py re-asserts the count identity at load time.
n_mols / n_pockets are the VERIFIED docking-successful counts measured 2026-08-03;
the loader asserts against them so a silently changed .pt can never pass as the same data.
EXCLUDED on purpose: DrugGPS / ResGen / DiffSBDD have no pocket-dir prefix in
ligand_filename (n_pockets = 0), so no off-target can be assigned. PIDiff has only
8.5 molecules per pocket. liGAN / CVAE / IPDiff / MolCraft / DeepICL / Ours(pignet)
duplicate the story already told by the kgdiff and AliDiff rows.
